test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Amendments to the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (GNCTD) Act 1991 made in March 2021 have been made with reference to which of the following articles of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 239 AA.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Delhi’s current status as a Union Territory with a Legislative Assembly is an outgrowth of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991 through which** Articles 239AA and 239BB** were introduced in the Constitution.
 
• The Government of NCT of Delhi( Amendment) Act, 2021 amends the Government of **National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991.**
 
• It provides a framework for the functioning of the Government of Delhi and the Legislative Assembly.
 
• It entered the presidential assent on **March 28, 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 368:**

 
 
• Article 368 lays down the process by which the Parliament can amend the constitution.
 
• The process is as followed. The Bill is introduced in either house of the parliament.
 
• The Bill must be passed by a total majority (irrespective of vacancies or absentees) and by a majority, not less than 2/3rd of people present and voting by both houses.
 
 
 
• **Article 55:**
 
 
• ARTICLE 55 Constitution Of India Article 55 - Manner of election of President.
 
• As far as practicable, there shall be uniformity in the scale of representation of the different States at the election of the President.
 
 
 
• **Article 318 B:**
 
 
• Power to make regulations as to conditions of service of members and staff of the Commission make provision with respect to the number of members of the staff of the Commission and their conditions of service handed that the conditions of service of a member of a Public Service Commission shall not be varied to his disadvantage after his appointment.
